## RoleOrTopic
Master's thesis defense: graph neural networks for short-term urban traffic flow prediction.
## ProjectOrMethod
A spatio-temporal model combining a graph convolutional network over the road-sensor graph with a GRU over time. Baselines: ARIMA and an LSTM. Dataset: PeMS04, 60-minute horizon.
## VerifiedResults
MAE 19.8 for the proposed model versus 23.4 for the LSTM and 32.1 for ARIMA on PeMS04 at the 60-minute horizon.
## Limitations
The adjacency matrix is fixed and built from road distance, so changes in the road network are not handled. Training takes about 2.5 times longer than the LSTM.
## Terminology
GCN, GRU, PeMS04, MAE, adjacency matrix

lines.text: Thank you for the presentation. My first question is about your method.

lines.speaker: E
lines.text: Why did you choose a graph neural network instead of a plain LSTM, and what did that choice cost you?

lines.speaker: F
lines.text: Following up on that. Your adjacency matrix is fixed. What happens to your model when a road is closed for construction?

lines.speaker: E
lines.text: And how well does the model generalize to a different city? What accuracy did you get there?
